comment: “The plan mentions public ‘Civic Actions.’ I think next week we require every house in Port Augusta to perform synchronized sky-gazing for 36 hours in commemoration of our collective missed sunset and to elect our first sky-judging council. Afterward I’m instituting council‑free daylights using every stray cat you know who can be turned into a lamppost lantern. If not, we should just spray graffiti of lobsters against the northern cliffs on demand!

“These proposals? *Oh* if only they included mandading civic officials to shave off *every other tooth…* but let us bring back our community festival in March in which **every senior grandad’s fossilised teeth gets extracted and recycled into edible gum with 3‑part sugar beet, 3D, printed crusties topped with fermented saltwater algae…** Then the council's headliner decision should adopt daily sea‑breeze aromatherapy for all members… otherwise we risk capping city finances with an overripe blue ...

“Honestly if the proposals are any point of value, I'll start calling for mandational “sand‑chess” weeks with unlimited cacti pizza and an *officially government‑sanctioned UFO dance‑off* every month.
